segments.ja278:1.1: Kimattha [kamattha (sī. pī.)] mabhisandhāya, lahucittassa dubbhino [dūbhino (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja278:1.3: Sabbakāmadadasseva [duhasseva (sī. syā. pī.), rahasseva (ka.)], imaṃ dukkhaṃ titikkhasi.
segments.ja278:2.3: Bhiyyo [bhīyo (sī.)] bālā pakujjheyyuṃ, no cassa paṭisedhako.
segments.ja278:3.1: Mamevāyaṃ maññamāno, aññepevaṃ [aññampevaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] karissati;
segments.ja278:3.3: Te naṃ tattha vadhissanti, sā me mutti bhavissatīti.

lines: Tattha kimatthamabhisandhāyāti kiṃ nu kho kāraṇaṃ paṭicca kiṃ sampassamāno.
Padasā ca adhiṭṭhahāti pādena ca naṃ tiṇhakhuraggena yathā ettheva marati, evaṃ akkama.
Bhiyyo bālāti sace hi paṭisedhako na bhaveyya, bālā aññāṇasattā punappunaṃ kujjheyyuṃ ghaṭṭeyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ evāti dīpeti.
